notes: §1985:XIII.3.9.2 prints three formats: 01 [data-name-1] [LINE] [NEXT GROUP] TYPE [USAGE DISPLAY]; level-number [data-name-1] [LINE] [USAGE DISPLAY]; and a format 3 entry with mandatory PICTURE and one of SOURCE/VALUE/SUM. In Format 1 (PDF page 602, rendered: braces, not brackets) CONTROL HEADING and CONTROL FOOTING each take a required {data-name | FINAL} operand, with no ON/FOR word and no OR PAGE. The format split is implemented at 85 by ReportSectionBinder#ScreenReportEntryClausePresence/#ScreenReportEntryFormats/#ScreenReportEntryClauseTable (COBOL2247) and the 2002 clause forms by VersionConformancePass (COBOL0900). The TYPE operand is not: the grammar (#reportGroupType, #reportControlName) takes the 2023 optional operand, ON/FOR and OR PAGE, and no 85 arm refuses them. Probes at --std 85, each COBOL2247/COBOL0900/COBOL2284/COBOL2423 as named: 01 with PIC/COLUMN/SOURCE (2247), 01 without TYPE (2247), TYPE at level 05 (2247), NEXT GROUP at level 05 (2284), format 3 with no PIC and VALUE only (2247+0900), with no SOURCE/VALUE/SUM (2247), with SOURCE and VALUE (2247), TYPE or PIC twice (2423), PRESENT WHEN, OCCURS, VARYING, COL, COLUMN RIGHT, multiple COLUMN, multiple LINE, SOURCE ROUNDED, SOURCE WS-AMT + 1, USAGE NATIONAL (0900). Accepted and correct: abbreviations RH/DE/CF, free clause order, format 2 group at 05 over a level 49 item, LINE n ON NEXT PAGE, VALUE ALL "*" and SPACES, BLANK WHEN ZERO, SIGN TRAILING/LEADING SEPARATE, JUST RIGHT, an edited -(4)9.99 SOURCE (prints ***  120-  -12.00). The witness (05 COLUMN 1 SOURCE WS-NAME with no PICTURE) is refused COBOL2247. kb/Work PB5242 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-reread2/rr-02.json).

next.reason: 1985 has three report group formats: level 01 with TYPE (and LINE/NEXT GROUP/USAGE), a format 2 group entry, and a format 3 elementary entry with mandatory PICTURE and one of SOURCE/VALUE/SUM (§1985:XIII.3.9.2; Table 1 of §1985:XIII.3.9.3 SR11 marks PIC 'M' in every row). 2023 has one entry (§2023:13.15.2) whose level split is carried by syntax rules: TYPE and NEXT GROUP only in level 1 (§2023:13.15.3 SR5, SR6), PICTURE/COLUMN/SOURCE/VALUE/SUM/GROUP INDICATE only in an elementary entry (SR11), COLUMN needs SOURCE, VALUE or SUM (SR10), clause order free after the entry-name (SR2). PICTURE is now required only with SOURCE or SUM (SR12) and 'may be omitted ... when an alphanumeric, boolean or national literal ... is specified in the VALUE clause' (SR14); the entry also adds USAGE NATIONAL, PRESENT WHEN, OCCURS and VARYING. 1985 entries keep their meaning; 2023 accepts entries 1985 refuses (looser).
